description: A reviewed source-bound audit artifact, not an automated certification or a claim that every state is fully designed. Re-review after changing hashed runtime or model files.
methods: All142 types and97 declared variants rendered from canonical source. 4153 isolated supplied-field samples, with generic gauges and warning badges excluded from equipment SVG comparison.

Chromium computed SVG geometry, paint, visibility, transforms and cadence compared at fixed animation time1100ms for every declared field option/end point. A difference establishes coupling, not engineering truth or aesthetic quality.

The final four-type numeric refinement was re-probed in isolation and merged into the unchanged broader inventory; source hashes were rechecked. Broad pause/offline/reduced guarantees remain covered by the merged measurements and release QA.

Ten common state sets measured actual CSS animation time progression over at least200ms; reduced motion tested separately. Low/high sets vary numeric fields together; they are test probes, not coherent plant operating points.
55 focused healthy/failure/repaired cases test semantics and preserve retained heat/leak effects. No blanket demand that inert switches animate or that every device catch fire.
All239 v2 placeholder descriptors exist; model-to-field behavior and repair lifecycle completeness are separate. v1 has80 base types and does not interpret variants.
limits: CSS phase samples cannot establish every intermediate frame or multi-field interaction.
A generic shared state contract, damage profile or gauge is not equivalent to bespoke equipment behavior.
Geometry reuse for compatible service variants is intentional; 91 variants do not need97 independent SVGs.
Repair is host/model-owned; the UI has no physics, IO, accident scheduler or autonomous escalation.
All models are editable normalized teaching placeholders, not calibrated hydraulic, thermodynamic, biological, electrical-protection or nuclear-safety models.

Visual comparison method was tightened during review to include SVG coordinates and modern CSS translate/rotate/scale; baseline files are retained privately as development evidence and are not a portable acceptance artifact.

knownGaps.finding: The current distribution substation model connects a CT data path but declares no relay observation binding, so the relay VALUE stays at its initial zero. Connectivity alone is not sampled-value propagation or protection logic.

Some supplied visual fields remain default values in the placeholder model: tracking/position, stress, capacitor steps and automatic mode are not complete dynamic trajectories. These controls can be rendered directly; that is distinct from being modeled.

Common damage injection/repair exists, but every type does not yet have an individually designed failure progression, degradation curve, secondary consequence, recovery sequence and scenario test. A reset to supplied state is not a complete lifecycle.

Some faults share a frozen physical picture: blade damage/seizure, or stuck/actuator fault. Readable state labels distinguish the cause; movement gates can differ. Do not count this as separately designed art for every fault.

28 of273 base numeric fields have no sampled SVG coupling beyond the generic readout. Some are honest telemetry or command indices and need no extra animation; review per equipment rather than requiring decorative motion.

Single-field states and selected failures were checked; arbitrary state combinations, transients, every fault-repair sequence and all browser/input/accessibility combinations are not exhaustively validated.

resolvedVisualGaps.finding: VALUE readout can change while the small internal dial remains a decorative fixed pointer. Make the pointer follow its declared reading or explicitly remove its measurement implication.
resolvedVisualGaps.resolution: Pressure pointer follows the same catalog-declared range as VALUE.

resolvedVisualGaps.finding: Declared level is exposed in the readout but not in a distinct battery-inventory feature.
resolvedVisualGaps.resolution: A battery drawer fill follows supplied level, retained when off.

resolvedVisualGaps.finding: A biofilter at level zero can retain bubbles; a flow meter supplied value zero retains a flow animation. These require deliberate no-fluid/no-flow presentation rules and regressions.
resolvedVisualGaps.resolution: Flow markers stop at zero and reverse for signed negative readings. Biofilter wet bubbles are absent when empty and clipped to liquid inventory; exterior paths remain independently indicated and dry media settles.
